text:
Dear Mr Reid,

as requested, I'm sending the amounts for my claim, set out item by item in the attached overview. In total it's CHF 3,000.

On your question about limiting the damage: I've done everything that can be done. My e-banking passwords are changed, the tablet has been locked through my account, and the police have the serial numbers. There's nothing still waiting on my list.

As for who might be responsible, it wasn't anyone from my household. Only my wife Eva Tanner and I live in the flat, and we were both away at her sister's over the Easter weekend when it happened.

I've attached the confirmation of my claim notification, so you have the case number.

Our keys and locks weren't affected, so I'm not claiming anything for that.

To put it on record: the theft happened at home, in our flat at Birkenweg 69 in Lucerne, on Sunday 5 April 2026.

Finally, the police report is attached as well. I reported the theft at the station in Lucerne the evening we got back.

Yours sincerely,
Henry Wälti
